title: Support for Multiple Active Quick Wizards
symptom: Currently only a single Quick Wizard is displayed for a given time period, limiting usefulness because users must switch between quick wizards and 'Carb' or 'Calculator' entries for multiple meal components.
evidence_quote: Currently only a single Quick Wizard is displayed for a given time period. This limits their usefulness since it means that users must switch between quick wizards and 'Carb' or 'Calculator' entries.
